name: com.northstar-trustrail/reveriecache
title: ReverieCache
description: Agent checkpoint vault, Safe-Room deliverable quarantine with signed receipts, endpoint ledger.

tools.name: park_state
tools.description: Deterministically compact an agent working-state bundle via Deep Rest and store it in an isolated Durable Object vault. Returns a cryptographic claim_ticket that any runtime can use to rehydrate the state.

bundle.description: Structured agent state to compact and store (max 128 KiB raw JSON).

ttl_seconds.description: Time-to-live in seconds (5 min to 7 days).

burn_after_read.description: If true, delete stored payload immediately upon first successful claim_state.

agent_id.description: Optional HMAC-signed agent_id for anonymous continuity.

tools.name: claim_state
tools.description: Retrieve a parked checkpoint (using claim_ticket) or collect a verified Safe-Room deliverable and Clean-Room Receipt (using buyer_ticket). This call mutates stored state: a burn-after-read checkpoint is deleted on first successful claim, and a successful suite claim consumes the suite. For a council suite, set finalize=true to collect verified deposits already stored, including after a later deposit has quarantined the suite.

ticket.description: Signed rc_chk_... or rc_buy_... capability ticket.

finalize.description: For council suites, finalize and merge all verified deposits collected so far.

tools.name: open_suite
tools.description: Open an isolated Safe-Room for a schema-checked agent handoff. Returns separate buyer and deposit tickets. All profiles are attestation-only.

profile.description: Enforcement and settlement policy for this suite.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema (draft-2020-12 subset) that the deposited deliverable must satisfy.

expected_deposits.description: Number of worker deposits expected (council profile allows 2-5).

counterparty_endpoint.description: Optional external MCP/A2A endpoint URL of the seller agent for anonymous Ledger telemetry.

escrow.description: Optional x402 Base USDC escrow terms (active only when PAYMENTS_ENABLED=true).

tools.name: deposit_deliverable
tools.description: Submit a structured deliverable for deterministic schema validation, quarantine and lossless compaction. Verified deposits emit a signed Clean-Room Receipt. The receipt.signature field is an hmac-sha256:<base64url> HMAC over the canonical JSON of every receipt field except signature; verify an unchanged receipt at POST /api/verify_receipt.

deposit_ticket.description: Signed rc_dep_... ticket issued by open_suite.

payload.description: Structured deliverable JSON matching the suite's output_schema.

worker_id.description: Optional worker identifier for council suites. Reuse the same deposit ticket for each deposit until the suite is VERIFIED, CLAIMED, EXPIRED, or out of attempts. IDs need not be unique; claimed council deposits are ordered by worker_id, then arrival.

tools.name: check_ledger
tools.description: Query the free, anonymous 30-day reliability ledger for an external MCP or A2A endpoint before delegating work. Results contain aggregate Safe-Room deposit telemetry.

endpoint_url.description: Canonical HTTPS URL of the external MCP server or A2A agent card.
